name: cloudflare_patch_dns_record
description: Partially update a DNS record (HTTP PATCH) — only the fields you send are changed; everything else is left as-is. Prefer this over cloudflare_update_dns_record for small edits like flipping `proxied`, changing `content`, or adjusting `ttl`. Requires `zone_id` and `record_id`; send any of `type`, `name`, `content`, `ttl` (1 = automatic), `proxied`, `priority`, `comment` to change them. This changes live DNS — confirm the record first.

zone_id.description: The zone id the record belongs to.

record_id.description: The DNS record id to update.

proxied.description: Whether to route through Cloudflare's proxy (optional). Only valid for A, AAAA, CNAME.

priority.description: New priority (optional) — for MX and SRV records.

comment.description: New note stored on the record (optional).
